dict.string: Oreja de Van Gogh — an independent audio companion. Not affiliated with OpenAI or Apple.
Oreja listens to the audio output of the apps you select so it can pause your music while they speak. Audio is analyzed locally as level only; nothing is recorded, stored, or uploaded.
Only if you turn on “Pause while I speak”: Oreja measures the level of your microphone to keep the music paused while you talk. The audio never leaves your Mac and nothing is recorded.
Oreja controls the Music app to pause and resume your music when ChatGPT starts and stops speaking. Oreja never reads your library or conversations.
